snippets.text: OpenAI's Codex lead, posting as thsottiaux, says GPT-6.1 Sol's default context in Codex and ChatGPT Work rises to 500k tokens from 272k, with a 1M maximum still selectable.
snippets.why: The change is meant to cut context compactions on long-running agent tasks; users can still override the default in either direction.

snippets.text: The same Codex lead also says OpenAI is not charging long-context fees for GPT-6.1 Sol when usage is drawn from a subscription, following the move to a 500k default.
snippets.why: Subscribers get the larger window without the extra long-context charge; the post does not say how API usage is billed.

snippets.text: Developer Theo posted a dashboard he made to track his Claude usage across several accounts and roughly predict how long his rate limits will last.
snippets.why: It shows how heavy coding-agent users are now budgeting around usage caps; the post drew about 275 likes within hours.

snippets.text: 9to5Mac reports Apple has tested microphones and an upgraded Siri Remote for a new Apple TV 4K, expected alongside the HomeView smart display at its Tuesday event.
snippets.why: Microphones in the remote or box would point to deeper voice-assistant use on Apple TV; Apple has not confirmed any of it.
